records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Wanted to check in on Quartz Systems' setup. If you haven't gotten to inviting the rest of the team yet, no rush -- just let me know if anything's in the way.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Quartz Systems set up
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for setting up Quartz Systems on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Quartz Systems* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no tickets, zero customer replies to two emails ([email:63836d32], [email:ee06f036]) and a no-show onboarding call ([calendar:f6cba0f7]). Total silence plus no setup progress makes unaided activation in the remaining 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Quartz Systems' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Sorry we missed each other on the call last week — easy to do in a busy stretch. I don't want to clutter your inbox, so just one thing: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project up is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through the first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
